notes.title: Easter Update !
notes.content:
Today’s Easter themed update features two new characters, one new gamemode, and one new map! Battle it out as the Easter Bunny or Eggie to capture the most eggs on the Easter Islands!

Eggie release video!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EPvze2XHGV0


Easter Bunny
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31223753/51057db641b979a5b4310b7ad135355f0fb69b13.png

Blast: Shoots a blast from his weapon
Carrot Bomb: Shoots an explosive carrot
Chirp: Throws an egg that hatches a chicken helper!


Eggie
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31223753/b0d6d04121c9e9ceaaf2ef7b005fd6a140bccc3a.png

Egg Toss: Throws an egg dealing damage
Beak Attack: Chomps his beak in front of him
Eggcident: Leaves an egg bomb where he is standing


Easter Islands
Cookies vs. Claus goes to the clouds in this new Easter themed map! Careful not to fall from the sky!

Egg Hunt 
Be the first cookie team to capture 5 Easter eggs and place them in your basket. If you’re playing as Santa, be sure to destroy 5 eggs so the cookies can’t get them!

Have fun!
Josh

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31223753/d25c69b09dfe54921c2b4f84a0f5531538727481.png

notes.title: V0.6.0 Major Vehicle Reworks, Character Updates, and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Hi All! Today's update features a major rework to vehicles. All vehicles now have 3 attacks, similar to cookie characters. Vehicles are now more powerful and there are more spread out on each map.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31223753/03ec430c6f1a3b7539aadbbceb7d67d4f9ea8a0c.png
Vehicle Reworks

Bomber

 Evasive flip
 Machine gun
 Bomb drop

Cookie Copter

 Evasive Flip
 Machine gun
 Triple Rocket shot

Planes

 Evasive Flip
 Machine gun
 Rocket (normal, ice, fire) shot

Nutcracker

 Quick dash
 Sword slice
 Knife throw

Robots 

 Quick dash
 Robopunch

Tanks

 Machine gun

UFO

Unicorn, Nardolph, Crabicorn

 Rainbow laser
 Magic shield



Character Updates

Cookies

All cookies now look in the direction you are walking, giving them a more lively feel

Rudy

Stay tuned for more updates this holiday season!

notes.title: 2018 Summer Update! New Map and Game Mode, new Cookie, and Santa reworks!
notes.content:
V0.4.0 is available for download!
Christmas is coming early this summer! Santa is going on the offensive as he drops in on the prestigious Cookie Castle.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31223753/48deeaf7b6e8bd12dd07c941ccce1aaaee9e2d8f.png

New Map - Cookie Cove

Sunny vacation island located as far away from the North Pole as it can be.
Cookies have a secret defense weapon hidden within the light house to repel the red menace
 Travel the map with the new Cookie Cannons! 

 New Game Mode and Classic Rework

Cookie Free For All - Battle solo with up to 8 cookies to prove you're the true cookie champion!
 Cookies vs. Claus - The classic game mode now supports 8 players in the quickplay lobby. Santa health has been increased appropriately to deal with all the cookies!

New NPCs

Magical Mermaid
Unicrab
Ghost Pirates
Sharky

New Pick-up - Cookie Dough Balls

 Patch up any holes made by santa with some freshly made cookie dough! Heals cookies for 5 hp

Santa Reworks

Santa
 New Weapon - Instead of his slow-firing, explosive projecticle weapon, he now has a Candy-cane machine gun.
 Santa's cookie pick-up has been changed to a small minigame. Right click once to reach your arm out, right click again at the right time to eat the cookie!

Rudolph
Rudolph's cookie pick has been adjust similarly to Santa's.

Stelf
Stelf's cookie pick-up has been replaced with a minigrapple hook


New Power Up - Grenade Launcher

Shoots timed explosives, contains 3 grenades

Improved Cookie and Claus Bots

 All Cookie bot's should now use vehicle's better
 Cookie bot's are more responsive to attacks
 Overall they have much better aim and should pose a much higher 
 The Claus bot has also been buffed greatly and should no longer get stuck
 Adjusting the bot difficulty will be added in a future patch

New Menus

 Lobby pages completely reworked. The quickplay lobby now allows voting for your favorite map and gamemode! Also allows up to 8 players for each mode
 Custom control pages reworked
Polished up all menus to feel better and be overall more responsive

Christmas Home Changes

Christmas tree should be easier to climb
Can now walk under trampoline
Climbing on the kitchen drawers and similar should be easier and more straight-foward

Major Fixes
Explosions kills now correctly apply to players kill count
Fixed bug that crashed game when two vehicles exploded
Games now end properly, scorebooard should always display correct scores.
Shooting should feel better and smoother
Mid game joiner's should join correctly after a slightly increased load time
Two Santa's should never be spawned in classic game mode
Characters should always spawn on the correct team
Challenges have been temporarily removed


Thank you for your cookie support. We will continue to try to improve game performance and quality as we prepare for new content this holiday season! Expect more frequent updates from now on!

notes.title: V0.3.2 - Item Rework, Cookie Changes, and More!
notes.content:
Hi All! In today's update we are introducing a new change to cookie items. Tiny present bubbles spawn around the map giving your cookie an item if you walk into them!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31223753/981ac4dc04eb1f132578445789be78887e5aafd3.png
Items
Items still replace your basic attack as before. Previous items have been reworked:

Cookie Gun

Lasts for 15 seconds
Shoots bullets quickly


Laser Gun

Lasts for 10 seconds
Shoots a mini laser dealing massive damage


Cookie Sword

Size increased
Lasts for 15 seconds
Damage increased from 4 to 8


*NEW ITEM* Bouncy bomb

Throwable bomb that bounces
 Explodes after 5 seconds


*NEW ITEM* Cookie Rocket

Shoots one explosive rocket



 Cookie Changes

General:

Cookie movement in air has been reduced
Cookies move slower and cannot jump while basic attacking
Camera view has been zoomed out allowing cookie players to see more
Attacks now shoot straighter
Smoother use of abilities while attacking


Choccy, Sugar, Ninjasnap, and Nisiar

Basic attacks now have range (150)
Basic attack speeds have been increased



In Game UI Update

Your character icon and health are now displayed in the bottom left
Current powerup and icons are displayed in the top left
Game info is now placed in the top right 


Map Changes

North Pole

Ice is now slippery!



Fixes

Creameo and Nisiar now play their sounds correctly
Tanks shield block now has sound
Santa bots should not disappear on the North Pole map



More cookie items will be added regularly as well as Santa Power Ups coming soon!
Reminder: New characters will be released in February :)

notes.title: New Map and Characters!
notes.content:
V0.3.0 is now ready for download!

This update features a new map, a new cookie, and a new santa character!

Plan for next update
The cookie battle does not end with Christmas. Cookies are cruelly eaten on a daily basis, especially during EACH holiday. The war has just begun.

For the next month we plan on fixing bugs, touching up the current maps/characters, and polishing the game as a whole. Expect some new characters or items, but the next major update will be in February featuring a new map and characters.

 Early Access #3 Patch Notes

New Map and Characters
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31223753/9ebb8db0bfcfc60b681f35696cff141618ca74cf.png

North Pole Map

New ai characters
Careful, cookies can't swim!

Stelf

Knife - Stelf throws a knife dealing huge damage
Dash snatch - Stelf dashes and picks up cookies/objects
Stelf Roll - Stelf rolls dropping a bomb in his place and turning invisible

Nisiar Laemtao

Nisiar blast - Nisiar throws up to 5 raisins that heal allies and hurt enemies
Nisiar bomb - Nisiar tosses a raisin explosion that heals allies and hurts enemies
Nisiar shield - Nisiar shields himself to become invincible and gains movement speed



Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where the game would sometimes not end on a cookie kill 
Bot kills no longer debug middle screen text
The Claus battle challenges now end correctly
Claus's candy cane no longer disappears
Matchmade games should no longer reset within the first 5 seconds
Santa cams now have the correct effects
Joining late puts you on the correct team

Have fun!
